## Deploys the Top Picks board + extension/exhaustion axis to live `main`

Replaces the old **Alpha leaders** discovery board (a pure residual-momentum sort whose top was always the most-extended names) with the validated two-axis **Top Picks** board, and adds a per-name **extension/exhaustion** read for the bubble-pullback risk a holder actually cares about.

**Rank — unchanged, validated** (`reports/top-picks-phase0.md`): alpha-led conviction blend `0.6·alpha + 0.4·mean(value,quality,profitability,low_vol,insider)`, beats residual momentum alone on PIT IC at every horizon. A value/cheapness tilt would *underperform* (US leaders continue), so we do **not** re-rank to "cheap".

**Extension axis — display-only, never scored** (`engine/extension.py`, validated in `reports/top-picks-freshness-phase0.md`, a long-only drawdown-aware PIT test, 138 rebalances): no screen reduces basket drawdown and a "freshness" rotation makes it worse — BUT the parabolic tail (`ext_z>2` vs a name's own history) is radioactive per-name (−94% maxDD / −1.37 skew). So:
- graded **Stretch** column (in-trend / steady / stretched / ⚠parabolic)
- **valuation-vs-own-history** chip (cheap / rich / richest)
- cohort-stretch **size-down banner**
- **hide stretched/parabolic** filter

Never re-sorts, never fades. Discovery nav refreshed to the current site nav (Top Picks slotted into the **United States** dropdown); dashboard "more" link relabelled.

**Verified against live `main`:** `build_discovery` runs clean on current data (no API drift), nav renders consistent with the site, light + dark mode OK. New tests 8 (extension) + 10 (top_picks); touched render-tests (`test_fear_euphoria`, `test_spvector_page`) still pass.

Deploys via `daily.yml` (rebuilds `site/` + Pages) after merge.
